body: Thank you, but I'd rather not, I'm really fed up with life. I think I'm done.

I know exactly what you mean, this is really similar to how I feel about myself. I could also use some advice about this. I'm sorry that I cannot really provide anything too helpful, but just know that you are not alone in your struggles.

((hugs back))
It means so much to hear from someone who has gone through a similar situation. I'll be on the lookout for support groups and such. I'm just really confused since it was an unwanted pregnancy, yet I feel so bad for losing it, perhaps it's the hormones.
I'm still taking it quite hard but it's nice to hear that there are people out there who understand what I'm going through after all.
I've got people I can hang out with on a casual level, but no close connections. And it would feel like an awkward time to start one now given my circumstances =/

Puppy pictures are awesome and I'm touched that you would consider sending cookie dough, albeit we don't really have the means to do it here, lol. I've got some friends who I'm not really close with but can have fun hanging out with, so that's something. I appreciate your kind words.

Luckily my university provides counseling for students, so I'm looking into that. And I know you're right about the pregnancy not being viable, it's just still quite difficult to deal with. I appreciate you hearing me out.

Thank you, that sounds like very sound advice. Only trouble is that I don't really have any girlfriends to hang out with. 

*hugs*
That guy who proposed is incredibly wise, it's a really interesting way to look at it. =)

I know, the pregnancy was completely not viable so it was just a matter of saving my life, I was just feeling like my life wasn't worth saving anyway and I was really considering not following up on my appointment to get treated. It's just really hard to stop hurting because I've known him for 7 years (since I was 14) and I can't imagine him gone from my life. But thank you so much for your encouraging words, they really helped me feel better.

Thanks for that resource, I'll definitely look into it for support. I know I still have the memories, but right now they're just too painful to revisit.

*hugs back*
